notes.title: Hardenville | Episode 2 Progress Update and Sneak Peek at Episode 3 and Beyond
notes.notes:
We hope you're doing great as summer rolls in! We know you’ve been waiting for the next episode of Hardenville!

Episode 2 - Progress Update
Episode 2, featuring the wild and unforgettable house party, was originally planned for a May release, and we were so close! But life threw in a little twist, again: our dev got hit with two unexpected financial bills that needed urgent attention. That meant picking up extra work fast, which naturally slowed things down a bit.

Even during those hectic, sleepless nights, we kept pushing forward whenever we could, and the cool part? Some of that extra work actually turned into content we’ll be using in Hardenville! So nothing was wasted, and those bills are officially behind us.

Now, we’re back in full swing, and development is moving fast! Episode 2 is currently 84% rendered, so we’re closer than ever to wrapping it up and hitting that release button. Thanks so much for your patience and support, we’re nearly there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/56c102c02b446c32831e4fc0e4da74b87b4b3cd8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/a4f40b63756505a97f3b8c1857a92312a10b0d78.jpg

But wait… there’s more 👀

Since we’re almost done with Episode 2, we wanted to give you a sneak peek of what’s coming next in the future episodes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/daadc5a859289b9dd9032b64aa69ffbe0cdaaae4.png

Episode 3 (Coming later this year!)
This one puts the spotlight on Johanna, Millie, and Emma, while still giving you some time with others as well.

- Emma invites you out for a sunny day at the beach with her closest. Sounds great, right? Until you all realize it’s… a nude beach day. Do you leave? Or join in, one item at a time?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/099979dbd34fd9ba837b90c6555ed4344b85f980.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/5c5e6fb73890b63fa561fa9106931f6f9a0d796f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/0ee0ba7fed49521db11cf3bf8d75d2319758e21d.jpg

- Johanna is feeling a little down lately. You’ve got two tickets to a local hockey match… and during a break, the kiss cam starts scanning the crowd. What happens next? That’s up to you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/4cfb5d621c8aff4425f659f4a9e5c3ff57884779.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/a2be55393421c753c587179d4260108bde3b8064.jpg

- Millie is deep into handball season, and her team is short a few players. Time to hit the court, and the locker room, as you help her team gear up for the final game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/15249abd0e62b3d4f40b7d5871f53ad03d2e3a5f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/f2516c36fd3ec1223f042c6dd6a548741b40410f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/1a6d134bcef3d532eed4968e92002a9efb57a5df.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/7a007b5579a6688b1f41caf9664e922fb92640dd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/569ff9d846417627af111b403f78a1c83d7d6d9d.jpg

Episode 4
The spotlight turns to your beloved Ariel, and yes, she’s an athlete too! Ariel, the swimmer, has invited you to train with her at the local public pool. That’s all we’ll reveal for now… but let’s just say it’s going to make a splash.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/20b6c29c86fe15e0ee954a3105edcd2f1f78ea1a.jpg

Thanks so much for sticking with us. Your support means the world, and we're beyond excited to bring you even more of the Hardenville story very soon.

Stay tuned, Episode 2 is dropping soon! Until then, tell us: which character are you most excited to hang out with?

notes.title: Hardenville The Prologue is scheduled for release this week!
notes.notes:
Exciting Announcement: Our Game Build Has Been Submitted for approval to Steam!

We're thrilled to share that our game build is now pending approval on Steam and, if everything goes smoothly, will be released by the end of this week! 🎉

Once approved, we'll bring you another update and aim to release the game the very next day. It will be simultaneously launched on Steam, Patreon, SubscriberStar, and Itch.IO.

Sneak Peek with Our New In-Game Videos!

We're offering a glimpse into our game with 4 in-game videos. Checking them out below!


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/256974469/movie480_vp9.webm?t=1696863380

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/256974470/movie480_vp9.webm?t=1696863384

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/256974468/movie480_vp9.webm?t=1696863392


About the Release and What's Next

This initial release—the Prologue—is the first of a 10-episode series. Although it's slightly shorter, we assure you that upcoming episodes are more substantial and equally thrilling!

With the bulk of the coding and location creation behind us, future releases will be much swifter. We're targeting the release of Episode 1 in approximately three months, boasting a size around twice that of the Prologue.

And while each subsequent episode will take between two to four months to produce, we're already brimming with electrifying ideas for a potential Season 2!
